# sortr

> sortr (https://sortr.io) is a free head-to-head ranking site: two items face
> off, you pick a favorite, and after enough matchups your full ranking emerges
> (pairwise comparison — no dragging items into tiers). Fandoms know the format
> as a "bias sorter" or "character sorter". Anyone can create a sorter for
> anything — K-pop groups, anime characters, albums, movies, games, food — and
> share it. When 3 or more people play the same sorter, their results combine
> into a community ranking.

## Key pages

- https://sortr.io/browse — browse and search all public sorters, by category
- https://sortr.io/create — create a sorter (account required)
- https://sortr.io/sorter/<slug> — a sorter's page; play it without an account

## Facts

- Free to play, no account needed; sign in only to create and save rankings
- Alternative to tier list makers: the ranking is computed from your choices
- Ties are supported — tied items share a rank (1, 1, 3…)
- Sorters can be public, unlisted (link-only), or private
- Community rankings aggregate all players' results per sorter
